title: Bram and the Signal
author: Lena Marchetti
blurb: Juniper Ashgrove, the last human technician on an automated relay station, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
